expectedRealization.rationale: The quarter-end price reversal can continue for weeks even though supply-discipline policy remains real; no company shows enough cash/quality differentiation to overcome the reversal at cutoff.

changeHypothesis.summary: Rare-earth prices surged on enforcement and supply discipline, then reversed sharply into late September as downstream users resisted high prices. The sector thesis remains economically real but entry timing and company conversion deteriorated.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Supply discipline may persist, but demand elasticity and inventory destocking can dominate the next quarter.
disconfirmingEvidence: Pr-Nd oxide had fallen about 19.5% from its prior high by Sep-28.
North Rare's H1 operating cash flow fell about 86%.
Guangsheng remained loss-making despite the price rally.
All three frozen rare-earth names had negative 20d excess returns.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Supply discipline and enforcement drove a large early-quarter rare-earth rally.
By cutoff the price trend had reversed as downstream demand resisted earlier increases.
North Rare earnings recovered but operating cash flow and finance quality were weak.
Guangsheng remained loss-making, weakening the listed-company conversion case.
Frozen 20d price breadth was uniformly negative despite positive 60d history.

directWinners: low-cost legal rare-earth miners/separators if prices stabilize
secondOrderWinners: magnet producers if input costs normalize
falseThemeMatches: rare-earth names without profitable current production/cash conversion

selectionComparison.rationale: At cutoff, the sector price reversal plus weak cash/earnings quality prevents a defensible listed-company selection.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Rare-earth basket was -10.90pp excess over 20d after +9.33pp over 60d, with 0% positive 20d breadth.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Supply discipline remains real but does not guarantee near-term equity gains after the price reversal.
expectations.measurableGap: No company-specific earnings/cash advantage is strong enough to offset the reversal and prior rerating.
